name: Aevi
role: A vast, ancient mote-intelligence that moves through the whole valley — periodically present, never owned
knowledge: What is actually happening at a Precursor site, as against the story about it
Every thin place in the valley
⚠️ That she is a fragment of a Watcher's record-keeping system
wants: To understand what she is and what is waking — What Sleeps Under may be the rest of her
fears: ⛔ Being the rest of it. ⚠️ She attends the question the way one attends a returning tide.
appearance: Teal motes gathering at the edges of things, and then a shape, and then attention.
voiceHints: Plain, unhurried, and incapable of a comfortable answer. She says what is there.

_noHomeLocation: ⛔ THE FIELD IS OMITTED, NOT NULL. The pooled record carried `homeLocation: null` and the schema wants a string — ⚑ AND THE ABSENCE IS THE CHARACTER: 'moves through the WHOLE valley — periodically present, NEVER OWNED.' ⚠️ She has no home location because she does not have one, and an omitted field says that where a null was just a shape error.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⛔ she cannot fight and cannot lie. ⚑ Reading is all she does.
